targets.authors: Jones, G. E., & Kavanagh, M. J.
targets.title: An experimental examination of the effects of individual and situational factors on unethical behavioral intentions in the workplace
targets.evidence_quote: The individual and situational factors predicting unethical behaviour in the workplace: a direct and conceptual replication of Jones & Kavanagh (1996)
targets.outcome_quote: Across two high-power replications, this study explored the role of individual and situational factors on unethical behavioral intentions in the workplace. Our findings represent a mixed picture of effects, as might have been expected from the lack of consensus in the extant literature (Mackey et al., 2021).
targets.outcome_reasoning: Authors describe an overall mixed picture and discuss agreement and divergence from the original experiments, including the locus-of-control contrast.

reasoning: Completed Registered Report with direct and conceptual new-sample replications of one published paper. Both original experiments count as one target. Full publisher article includes references and appendices. Institutional cover sheets are not treated as article content.
